business.body:
- "Our Growth Journey Across 28 Years" — from the first 2,500 TCD sugar unit at Libberheri, Roorkee (Uttarakhand) in 1998 to four sugar units: Libberheri, Barkatpur (Bijnore, UP), Khaikheri (Muzzafarnagar, UP) and Shermau (Saharanpur, UP).
- "Uttam Sugars maintains a customer-centric approach, consistently aligning product offerings with market demands... We have strategically diversified our product range to cater to both B2B and B2C markets."
- "Our supply chain extends to diverse sectors, including food and pharmaceutical companies, bakeries, and distilleries"; the deck also cites association with "India's premier hotel and cafe chains".
- Promoter holding of 74.71% on total issued capital of 3,81,38,120 shares; listed on NSE (UTTAMSUGAR) and BSE (532729).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Subsidiary] Uttam Distilleries Limited (UDL) is named as a subsidiary; its 40 KLPD distillery capacity is explicitly excluded from the headline distillery capacity figures.
- [Shareholding conflict] The deck gives two shareholding splits that do not agree: "Public Holding (%) 25.29%" in the shares-information table, versus "Promoters holding : 74.71% / Institution : 0.04% / Public : 25.25%" on the shareholding-details slide.
- [Journey dating] The growth-journey timeline lists its year labels (1998, 2001, 2004, 2005, 2007, 2011, 2012, 2015, 2016, 2018, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) separately from the milestone text, so the year-to-milestone binding is only partly recoverable from the extracted text.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Uttam Sugar Mills as a 28-year-old integrated sugar company operating four units across Uttarakhand and Uttar Pradesh with combined 27,000 TCD cane crushing, distillery and cogeneration power capacity, and a diversified B2B/B2C sugar portfolio spanning pharma, invert and branded specialty sugars.
